summary: The Shutdown Fairness Act provides continuous appropriations to pay federal employees, certain contractors, and active-duty members of the Armed Forces who are required to work during a government shutdown. Under current law, these workers are not paid until a shutdown ends. This bill ensures they receive regular pay and benefits during a lapse in appropriations, taking effect as if enacted on September 30, 2025.

affected_groups.effect: Receive regular pay and benefits during a government shutdown instead of waiting until the shutdown ends.
Receive pay if they support excepted federal employees and are required to work during a lapse in appropriations.
Covered under the definition of excepted employees to ensure continuous pay during a shutdown.
affected_groups.group: Members of the Armed Forces on active duty

key_provisions: Appropriates necessary funds for pay, allowances, benefits, and other standard payments to excepted federal employees during a government shutdown.
Expands the definition of excepted employees to include certain contractors who support federal employees during a shutdown and are required to work.
Includes members of the Armed Forces on active duty within the definition of excepted employees.
Prohibits agencies from using funds provided by this bill during periods when continuing appropriations are in effect.
Establishes a retroactive effective date of September 30, 2025.
missing_information: Total cost estimates for providing continuous pay during government shutdowns.
Specific criteria for which contractors qualify as supporting excepted employees.
summary_detail.plain_summary: The Shutdown Fairness Act provides continuous appropriations to pay federal employees, certain contractors, and active-duty members of the Armed Forces who are required to work during a government shutdown. Under current law, these workers are not paid until a shutdown ends. This bill ensures they receive regular pay and benefits during a lapse in appropriations, taking effect as if enacted on September 30, 2025.
summary_detail.significance: This bill changes how government personnel and certain contractors are compensated during federal funding gaps by guaranteeing pay during the shutdown rather than after it concludes.
